(not exactly sure who can edit this document; sending here if someone might know) Hi another question. I see that the contributions in json is given in hex (G1 and G2). may i know how is it represented? is it similar to eip2537 where the hex is a concatenation of x and y affine coordinates? <CarlBeek> no, it’s just the affine x coordinate, but with an extra few bits representing which y coordinate: https://github.com/zkcrypto/pairing/blob/34aa52b0f7bef705917252ea63e5a13fa01af551/src/bls12_381/README.md#serialization ah thanks for clearing it up for me ~~btw could you point me to the specs which describes this? cant seem to find it~~ I didn't see any acceptance..but now when I try to sign in it shows I have already contributed...how to verify??? Bcoz in the contributors list, I don't see my github I'd .

excerpts.content: Hi another question. I see that the contributions in json is given in hex (G1 and G2). may i know how is it represented? is it similar to eip2537 where the hex is a concatenation of x and y affine coordinates?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <CarlBeek> no, it’s just the affine x coordinate, but with an extra few bits representing which y coordinate: https://github.com/zkcrypto/pairing/blob/34aa52b0f7bef705917252ea63e5a13fa01af551/src/bls12_381/README.md#serialization
